business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K Item 1 and the Q3 2026 10-Q MD&A
business_model.claim: Pacira sells non-opioid pain products: EXPAREL, a long-acting local analgesic for postsurgical pain, ZILRETTA, an extended-release knee osteoarthritis injection, and until July 2026 the iovera° cryoanalgesia device. It also has pipeline programs, led by the PCRX-201 gene therapy for knee osteoarthritis.
quotes: We have three commercialized non-opioid treatments: EXPAREL® (bupivacaine liposome injectable suspension), ZILRETTA® (triamcinolone acetonide extended-release injectable suspension) and iovera®°.

business_model.claim: EXPAREL is the flagship and dominant revenue source: $575.1 million of 2025 net product sales, 79% of 2025 total revenues.
quotes: During 2025, sales of EXPAREL accounted for 79% of our total revenue, and we expect EXPAREL sales will remain of primary importance for the foreseeable future.

business_model.claim: ZILRETTA is the second product, $116.6 million or 16% of 2025 revenue. It is sold through a physician 'buy and bill' model.
quotes: ZILRETTA is a physician-administered product, and therefore physicians are required to purchase and manage the inventory of ZILRETTA, prior to administering the product to patients.

business_model.claim: Customers are hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers and physicians. EXPAREL is drop-shipped to end-users, with orders placed through wholesalers or directly. Hospital formulary approval is a gating step for sales.
quotes: We drop-ship EXPAREL directly to end-users based on orders placed to wholesalers or directly to us, and there is no product held by wholesalers.
secure formulary approvals for EXPAREL at a substantial number of targeted hospitals and ASCs

business_model.claim: The company reports a single operating segment.
quotes: We operate and report our financial information in one segment.

business_model.claim: EXPAREL revenue growth in 2025 came from volume. Gross vial volume rose 6%, partly offset by vial mix shift and lower net selling price per unit, tied to group purchasing organization contracting allowances.
quotes: Components of the increase included a 6% increase in gross vial volume, which was partially offset by a shift in vial mix and decreases in net selling price per unit in 2025 versus 2024.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K Item 1A and the Q2 2026 earnings release
business_model.claim: Reimbursement is a demand driver. Separate Medicare reimbursement for qualifying non-opioids under the NOPAIN Act, and UnitedHealthcare's separate reimbursement for EXPAREL, move EXPAREL outside the surgical bundle.
quotes: UnitedHealthcare is now providing separate reimbursement for EXPAREL® (bupivacaine liposome injectable suspension) across outpatient settings, including hospital outpatient departments and ambulatory surgery centers.

business_model.claim: ZILRETTA revenue fell 1% in 2025 as a 4% drop in kit volume outweighed a 3% rise in net selling price per unit.

growth_thesis.basis: Inferred from the 10-Q cash flow and income statements.
growth_thesis.claim: Cash generation and share repurchases are lifting per-share results. Nine-month operating cash flow was 133,210 versus 108,305 (statement in thousands of USD). Treasury purchases were 50,045, and diluted weighted shares were 40,681 versus 45,729 (shares in thousands). Continued per-share growth requires sustained operating cash flow.

ZILRETTA is a secondary, flatter contributor. Revenue fell 1% in 2025 on a 4% drop in kit volume, partly offset by a 3% price gain. A July 2025 co-promotion with J&J MedTech is intended to support it. Growth requires kit volume to recover against inexpensive generic steroids.
quotes: ZILRETTA revenue decreased 1% in 2025 versus 2024, primarily due to a 4% decrease in kit volume, partially offset by a 3% increase in net selling price per unit.

growth_thesis.basis: Program status stated in the 10-Q; the spending is from the 10-Q income statement.
growth_thesis.claim: The pipeline (PCRX-201 and PCRX-2002, both Phase 2) is a future growth option with no revenue yet. Nine-month R&D was 84,997 versus 79,859 (statement in thousands of USD). Growth from it requires clinical success and eventual approval.
quotes: We are also advancing two Phase 2 clinical programs

growth_thesis.basis: Divestiture terms stated in the earnings release and 10-Q; the revenue effect is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Selling iovera° trades a small growing product line for cash and a share of future milestones, so EXPAREL and ZILRETTA must carry growth. The sale closed on July 31, 2026 for cash of $73.6 million, with up to an additional $70 million in revenue-based milestones possible. iovera° grew 6% in 2025.
quotes: The transaction closed on July 31, 2026 and the Company received cash of $73.6 million, after purchase price adjustments.

growth_thesis.claim: EXPAREL's growth depends on keeping its patent protection and its cost structure. The company lists 23 EXPAREL patents in the Orange Book, expiring between January 2041 and July 2044. Two Chinese generic filers have challenged EXPAREL, and a November 2026 appeals ruling now requires royalties on the larger-scale process.
quotes: With these two new patents, there are currently 23 EXPAREL patents listed in the Orange Book, all with an expiration date between January 2041 and July 2044.

On November 6, 2026, the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit reversed the District Court’s judgment in part, holding that the Company owes royalties on EXPAREL manufactured using its 200-liter process and directing the District Court to enter judgement in favor of RDF on that claim.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the 8-Ks, the 10-Q and the screener row.
growth_thesis.claim: The pending Viatris acquisition conditions the whole standalone growth case. Viatris has offered $36.50 per share in cash, and the screener price is 36.48. The company has withdrawn its 2026 guidance, so management's own growth outlook is not available.
quotes: In addition, the Company is withdrawing its previously issued 2026 financial guidance and will not provide further updates to such guidance during the pendency of the proposed Offer and Merger.

material_events.basis: stated in the cited items (8-K and 10-Q)
material_events.claim: Pacira signed a merger agreement with Viatris; Viatris's subsidiary commenced a cash tender offer at $36.50 per share on October 30, 2026, with closing expected before year-end 2026 subject to conditions.
quotes: at an offer price of $36.50 per Share in cash, net of applicable withholding taxes and without interest
The Merger is expected to close before the end of the calendar year 2026, subject to the satisfaction or waiver of customary conditions

material_events.basis: stated in the cited 8-K; the date is the period printed on the item, since the text itself gives no date
material_events.claim: Pacira withdrew its 2026 financial guidance and said it will not issue a Q3 2026 earnings release or hold a call because of the proposed Offer and Merger.
quotes: the Company is withdrawing its previously issued 2026 financial guidance and will not provide further updates to such guidance during the pendency of the proposed Offer and Merger.

material_events.claim: Pacira completed the divestiture of its iovera° business to Zimmer for up to $140.0 million; it received $73.6 million in cash at closing after purchase price adjustments.
quotes: we completed the divestiture of iovera°
The transaction closed on July 31, 2026

material_events.claim: The Ninth Circuit reversed in part the District Court's judgment in the RDF royalty dispute, holding that Pacira owes royalties on EXPAREL made using its larger-scale manufacturing process.
quotes: On November 6, 2026, the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit reversed the District Court’s judgment in part, holding that the Company owes royalties on EXPAREL manufactured using its 200-liter process and directing the District Court to enter judgement in favor of RDF on that claim.

risks.basis: Stated in P5 and P4; the price-to-offer comparison is inferred from S0 and P4.
risks.claim: The Viatris tender offer is priced at $36.50 per Share and the screener price of 36.48 sits just below it. The company says the stock price could fall if the Merger is not completed, because closing conditions are not all in its control.
quotes: our stock price could fall to the extent that our current stock price reflects an assumption that the Merger will be completed

risks.claim: While the Merger is pending, contractual restrictions limit how the business is run, and a termination fee of $62.0 million may be payable under certain circumstances.
quotes: While the Merger is pending, we are subject to contractual restrictions that could harm our business, operating results, and our stock price.
The Merger Agreement provides Viatris and Pacira with certain termination rights and, under certain circumstances, may require us to pay Viatris a termination fee of $62.0 million.

risks.basis: Stated in P8; the counter-reading is inferred from the wording of P8 and the existence of the 10-Q (F1-F3).
risks.claim: The company withdrew its previously issued full-year guidance and will not update it while the Offer and Merger are pending. It also skipped the usual earnings release and call for the quarter.
quotes: In light of the proposed Offer and Merger, the Company will not issue an earnings release for the quarterly period ended September 30, 2026, nor will it hold a conference call to discuss its financial results and recent developments.

risks.basis: The ruling is stated in P7; the cost and repayment effects are inferred from P7 and P3.
risks.claim: The Ninth Circuit ruled that Pacira owes royalties to RDF on EXPAREL made under the 200-liter process, reversing the District Court in part. The District Court had ordered RDF to repay $23.1 million and Pacira had received a $28.3 million cash payment.
quotes: On November 6, 2026, the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit reversed the District Court’s judgment in part, holding that the Company owes royalties on EXPAREL manufactured using its 200-liter process and directing the District Court to enter judgement in favor of RDF on that claim.

risks.basis: Stated in P2 and P3; the patent count comes from P4.
risks.claim: EXPAREL accounted for 79% of 2025 revenue, and two generic manufacturers have filed ANDAs seeking to sell a generic EXPAREL in the U.S. Pacira has sued them for patent infringement.
quotes: In October 2025, we received two separate Paragraph IV Certifications from two Chinese generic drug manufacturers—WhiteOak and Qilu—each advising that they had submitted an ANDA to the FDA seeking authorization from the FDA to manufacture, use or sell a generic version of EXPAREL in the U.S.

risks.basis: Figures are stated in F2; the interpretation of the non-recurring items is inferred.
risks.claim: Third-quarter revenue of 176,653 (table in thousands) was below 179,516 a year earlier. Third-quarter net income of 28,521 included a gain on divestiture of 6,617 and income tax expense of only 293, so the headline profit rise may not reflect core operations.

the Company will not issue an earnings release for the quarterly period ended September 30, 2026

verdict_reason: an offer to acquire the company is announced and pending: the price follows the offer's terms, not the standalone value shown (on the value alone: WATCH, expected return +3.1 points a year against the required return over 3 years (BUY needs 4 or more))
